headline: Growthpoint extends renewable energy supply to Standard Bank branches
summary: Growthpoint Properties is providing Standard Bank retail branches with renewable power generated from onsite solar panels and independent power producer wheeling agreements.
why: Corporate adoption of green energy solutions lowers operating expenses and aligns commercial real estate portfolios with institutional ESG mandates.

impacts.name: Growthpoint Properties
impacts.why: Expanding green power supply to commercial banking branches.
